listings.title: Amifa Moon and Sky Wall Stickers (Large)
listings.bodyHtml:
Transform any space instantly with these celestial Amifa Wall Stickers! Choose between Moon (gorgeous moons and golden constellations) and Sky (stunning, gold-rimmed sunsets, auroras, and starry nights). Just peel, stick, and enjoy an infinite, dreamy view—no telescope required! Can also be used to decorate your notebooks and so much more.

Available in Moon and Sky designs

listings.title: Zebra Oil Based Fineliner Double-Sided Marker (0.3mm/0.7mm)
listings.bodyHtml:
Double the tips, double the fun! Say hello to your new go-to for all things fine and fancy: the Zebra Mackee Care Double-Sided Fineliner Marker! Whether you're outlining, detailing, or adding a pop of vibrant color, this pen's got your back (and your front!). With a delicate fineliner on one end and a slightly broader marker on the other, you're ready for precision and presence. Get ready to conquer your creative quests with this clever little workhorse!

Available in black, blue and red.
listings.productCategory: Office Supplies > Office Instruments > Writing & Drawing Instruments > Markers & Highlighters > Markers

listings.title: Pilot ILMILY Two-Colour Ballpoint Pen 04.mm
listings.bodyHtml:
Why choose one color when you can have two?

Meet the Pilot ILMILY Two-Tone Ballpoint Pens – your new favorite desk companions! These aren't your average pens: using the eraser each one transforms into a harmonious colour for notes that are as stylish as they are sophisticated. Get ready to elevate your doodles, lists, and letters with a pen that's double the fun and double the chic!

Available in Wine Red/Gray, Emerald/Mint, Grape/Lavender and Navy/Gray.
listings.productCategory: Office Supplies > Office Instruments > Writing & Drawing Instruments > Pens & Pencils > Pens > Ballpoint Pens

listings.title: Pilot ILMILY 0.5mm Nuance Black Pen Collection
listings.bodyHtml:
Say goodbye to plain old black and hello to the Pilot ILMILY Nuance Black Gel Pens! These aren't just pens - they're your new secret weapon for adding subtle sophistication to every stroke. With six gorgeous "nuance black" shades you get all the sleekness of black with a whisper of color. Smooth as silk and suitable for all occasions: from business to school to journalling. The smooth barrel and discreet yet supremely comfortable rubber grip ensure a high-quality feel.

Available in: Blue, Green, Yellow, Brown, Red and Violet
listings.productCategory: Office Supplies > Office Instruments > Writing & Drawing Instruments > Pens & Pencils > Pens > Gel Pens

Get your study game on with these five-colour sets and actually know where the highlight ends. Game changers for both righties and lefties!

Available in: Light and Classic Colours

listings.title: AmifaSpecial A5 Two-Zipper Net Stationery Case
listings.bodyHtml:
Stash your stationery in plain sight with our super fun A5 net case! Perfect for organising your bits and bobs with a cheeky peek-a-boo flair.

Available in: Green and Purple
listings.productCategory: Office Supplies > Filing & Organization > Pen & Pencil Cases

listings.title: Journalling Starter Kit
listings.bodyHtml:
Everything you need to start your journalling journey. This complete starter kit includes a quality notebook for daily entries, a pen or marker , decorative stickers, double-sided glue tape, and a convenient pouch to keep all your supplies organized and portable. Perfect for beginners or anyone looking to establish a consistent journalling habit. Tell us about your hobbies, favourite colours and animals and we will customise it just for you.

These photos are to give you an idea of the types of products that will be included in your kit!
listings.productCategory: Office Supplies > General Office Supplies > Paper Products > Notebooks & Notepads > Journals

listings.title: Amifa Art Card Set — Mocha & Black Themes
listings.bodyHtml:
Get your monochrome on with this artsy card set! Perfect for sending mini noir and sepia masterpieces to your pen pals, or just jazzing up your mood board with that vintage-vibe. Warning: May cause existential pondering and a sudden urge to drink black coffee. 8 cards in each set.

Available in Black and Brown designs
listings.productCategory: Arts & Entertainment > Hobbies & Creative Arts > Arts & Crafts > Art & Crafting Materials > Art & Craft Paper > Cardstock & Scrapbooking Paper > Scrapbooking Paper

listings.title: Amifa Art Card Set — Land and City Scapes
listings.bodyHtml:
Artsy aesthetic overload! Get your hands on these moody little postcards, perfect for pretending you have your life together (even if you're just mainlining caffeine and quoting Shakespeare). 8 cards in each pack.

Available in: Black and Pink
listings.productCategory: Arts & Entertainment > Hobbies & Creative Arts > Arts & Crafts > Art & Crafting Materials > Art & Craft Paper > Cardstock & Scrapbooking Paper > Scrapbooking Paper

listings.title: Amifa Photos & Doodles Stickers (29 — 36 pieces)
listings.bodyHtml:
Dive into a world of whimsy with our Photos & Doodles Stickers! Each pack features charming photo snippets and adorable doodles across delightful Rain, Outdoor, and Indoor themes. Perfect for personalising your planners, journals, or anything that needs a touch of playful charm. Get sticking!

Available in: Indoor, Outdoor and Rain

listings.bodyHtml:

9 designs x 6 = 54 flake stickers per pack.
listings.productCategory: Arts & Entertainment > Hobbies & Creative Arts > Arts & Crafts > Art & Crafting Materials > Embellishments & Trims > Decorative Stickers

listings.title: Kyowa Kawaii Fluffy Shima-Enaga Letter Set
listings.bodyHtml:

listings.bodyHtml:

Available in: Blue and Beige
